origin.description: Polynomial fit of a parametric curve, optionally through prescribed points.
origin.usage: curvefit(u, x, y, n, U = NULL, V = NULL)
origin.details: Degree 2 fit of (u^2, 2u + 1) on six knots from 0 to 1.
origin.value: Polynomial fit of a parametric curve, optionally through prescribed points.
origin.example: local({u<-seq(0, 1, length.out=6); with(curvefit(u, u^2, 2*u+1, 2), c(xp, yp, px, py))})

translation.description: Polynomial fit of a parametric curve, optionally through prescribed points.
translation.usage: curvefit(u, x, y, n, U = NULL, V = NULL)
translation.details: Degree 2 fit of (u^2, 2u + 1) on six knots from 0 to 1.
translation.value: Polynomial fit of a parametric curve, optionally through prescribed points.
translation.example: (lambda u, z: np.concatenate([z['xp'], z['yp'], np.ravel(z['px'], order='F'), np.ravel(z['py'], order='F')]))(np.linspace(0, 1, 6), curvefit(np.linspace(0, 1, 6), np.linspace(0, 1, 6)**2, 2*np.linspace(0, 1, 6)+1, 2))
